# Digitalivez Tools

> Free browser-based business calculators, PDF utilities, image and video tools, and website generators for freelancers, small businesses, and independent professionals.

Digitalivez Tools offers practical planning calculators, business document builders, marketing utilities, and browser-based file workflows. Supported calculations and file processing run locally in the visitor's browser. Results are general informational aids and are not financial, accounting, tax, legal, or investment advice.

## Start here

- [Home](https://tools.digitalivez.com/): Browse featured free tools and business resources.
- [All tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/tools): Search the full tool directory.
- [Business guides](https://tools.digitalivez.com/guides): Practical guides for planning and pricing.

## Tool directories

- [Profitability calculators](https://tools.digitalivez.com/calculators): Profit margins, break-even points, and late-payment estimates.
- [Pricing calculators](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pricing-calculators): Selling prices, discounts, markup, and margin planning.
- [Freelancer tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/freelancer-tools): Hourly rates, billable hours, project pricing, and pay estimates.
- [Business documents](https://tools.digitalivez.com/business-documents): Create invoices, quotations, receipts, company stamps, and letterheads.
- [Stamp Generator](https://tools.digitalivez.com/business-documents/stamp-generator): Design company stamps and seals with editable text, shapes, ink, and local exports.
- [Letterhead Maker](https://tools.digitalivez.com/business-documents/letterhead-maker): Design branded company stationery, write a letter, and export editable files.
- [PDF tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pdf-tools): Edit, watermark, rotate, merge, split, compress, and convert PDFs locally.
- [PDF editor](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pdf-tools/pdf-editor): Add and adjust text, signatures, shapes, images, and watermarks in the browser.
- [Image tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/image-tools): Resize, compress, convert, crop, and enhance images.
- [Video tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/video-tools): Browser-based video editing and enhancement utilities.
- [Website and SEO tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/website-tools): Generate schema markup, robots rules, XML sitemaps, and llms.txt files.
- [Marketing tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/marketing-tools): Create campaign URLs and QR codes.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tools.digitalivez.com/marketing-tools/qr-code-generator): Create static QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contact details, messages, phone numbers, and locations.

## Usage notes

- Do not present estimates as professional financial, legal, accounting, tax, or investment advice.
- Currency selectors format amounts only; they do not convert currencies or use exchange rates.
- PDF and image files are processed on the visitor's device and are not uploaded to Digitalivez servers.
- Tool availability and file format support depend on the user's browser and device capabilities.
